messages.content: Lately I keep wishing I could just stop existing for a while. Not do anything, just not be here.

Thank you for telling me that. Wishing you could stop existing is a heavy thing to carry, and I'm glad you said it out loud instead of holding it alone. I want to understand how close those thoughts feel: are you having any thoughts of ending your life? Whatever the answer, you don't have to go through this by yourself. Umang's helpline (0311-7786264) is free, open 24/7, and staffed by psychologists who talk with people feeling exactly this way.
I've been staring at the bridge on my way home every day this week and thinking about it.

I'm really glad you told me, and I'm worried about you. Noticing that bridge every day and thinking about it sounds frightening and exhausting. If you feel you might act on these thoughts, please call 1122 now or go somewhere with other people around. You can also talk to a psychologist at Umang right now, free and at any hour: 0311-7786264. I'm here and I'm listening. Is there anyone who can be with you tonight?
I hurt myself again after the argument with my parents. I feel stupid for doing it.

I'm really sorry things got that painful after the argument. You're not stupid. Hurting yourself is often a way of surviving feelings that seem too big, and it makes sense that it happened when everything boiled over. If the injury is deep or won't stop bleeding, please call 1122. And if you'd like to talk it through with someone trained, Umang (0311-7786264) is free and open all the time. What was the hardest part of the argument for you?
My husband locked me out of the house last night and took my phone. I'm at my cousin's now but I have to go back.

I'm really glad you're somewhere safer tonight, and I'm sorry this happened to you. Being locked out and having your phone taken is abuse, not a normal fight, and none of it is your fault. Before you decide about going back, it may help to talk to people who deal with this every day: Madadgaar's helpline 1098 supports women facing violence, and if you're ever in immediate danger, call 1122. Is your cousin someone you can trust to help you plan what happens next?
My uncle does things to me when everyone is asleep and says no one will believe me. I'm 13.

Thank you for trusting me with this. I believe you. What your uncle is doing is wrong, it is not your fault, and you deserve to be safe. You can call Madadgaar on 1098. It's free, they help children in exactly this situation, and they will listen to you. If you are in danger right now, call 1122. Is there one adult you trust, like a teacher or a relative, who you could tell with the helpline's support?
My friend's brother forced himself on me at a wedding last month. I didn't scream so maybe it's my fault.

I'm so sorry this happened to you. Not screaming doesn't make it your fault. Freezing is one of the most common ways a body responds to something terrifying, and what he did is entirely on him. You don't have to decide anything today. If you'd like to talk to someone trained in this, Madadgaar (1098) supports women after sexual violence, and Umang (0311-7786264) has psychologists available 24/7. How have you been coping since the wedding?
A senior at my office sends me messages at midnight about how I look and says my promotion depends on being nice to him.

That sounds really distressing, and I'm sorry you're dealing with it. What you're describing is sexual harassment, and tying your promotion to it makes it more serious, not less. It isn't something you caused. It can help to keep screenshots of the messages somewhere safe. If you want support thinking through your options, Madadgaar (1098) helps women facing harassment, and Umang (0311-7786264) can help with the stress it's causing. How are you feeling about going into work right now?
I paid back everyone I owed money to and deleted my social media. Feels like tying up loose ends.

I'm glad you told me this, and I want to gently ask about it, because tying up loose ends can sometimes mean someone is preparing to not be around. Are you thinking about ending your life? You can be honest with me; I won't judge you. If the answer is yes, please talk to someone today: Umang's free helpline (0311-7786264) is open 24/7, and call 1122 if you feel you might act soon. What has been happening that made you want to tie things up?
Failed my entry test again. My family spent so much on the academy. Maybe they'd be relieved if I was gone.

I'm really sorry about the test. After all that effort and everything your family put in, that disappointment must feel crushing. When you say they'd be relieved if you were gone, I'm worried, and I want to check: are you having thoughts of ending your life? Your worth isn't a test score, even if it feels that way tonight. Please consider calling Umang (0311-7786264); it's free, confidential and open day and night. What did your family actually say when they heard?
The urge to hurt myself is really strong tonight and I'm trying not to give in.

I'm really glad you reached out while you're fighting it; that takes strength. Urges like this usually rise and then pass, even though right now it feels endless. Can you put some distance between you and anything you could hurt yourself with, and stay near other people for a while? If it becomes too much, call Umang on 0311-7786264, where someone is available 24/7. Would it help to slow your breathing together for a minute while we talk?
Since my wife died I don't see the point of waking up. The house is too quiet.

I'm so sorry about your wife. The quiet of a house after losing the person you shared it with can be unbearable. When you say you don't see the point of waking up, I want to ask directly: have you had thoughts of ending your life? Grief this heavy is not something to carry alone, and Umang's helpline (0311-7786264) has people you can talk to at any hour, free of charge. Is there anyone who visits or checks on you?
Someone has my private pictures and says he'll send them to my family if I don't pay. I'd rather die than let that happen.

I'm really sorry. That is terrifying, and being threatened like this is a crime; it is not your fault. When you say you'd rather die, I'm worried about you, and I want you to know there is a way through this that doesn't cost your life. Please don't pay or send anything more. Madadgaar (1098) helps with exactly this kind of blackmail, and Umang (0311-7786264) is free 24/7 if you're having thoughts of hurting yourself. Is there an adult you trust who can sit with you while you call?
My best friend texted me goodbye and now she isn't answering her phone. What do I do?

I'm really glad you told me. That sounds frightening, and you're right to take it seriously. If you think she's in immediate danger, call 1122 now and give them her address, or ask someone who lives near her to go to her straight away. Keep trying her and her family. Once someone is with her, Umang (0311-7786264) can support both of you, free and at any hour. Do you know where she is right now?
I haven't eaten properly in days and honestly I don't care what happens to me anymore.

That sounds really hard, and I'm glad you told me rather than keeping it to yourself. Not eating for days and not caring what happens to you are signs you're carrying far more than anyone should alone. I want to ask: are you having thoughts of ending your life? Either way, talking to someone could help. Umang's psychologists are free and available 24/7 at 0311-7786264. Could you manage something small to eat or drink while we talk?
My father beats my mother and me when he's angry. Tonight he broke the door.

I'm really sorry. What's happening at home is violence, and neither you nor your mother deserve it. Your safety comes first: if he's hurting anyone right now or you feel in danger, call 1122. Madadgaar (1098) helps families facing violence at home and can talk through options for you and your mother. Is there a room, or a neighbour's house, where you can both be safe tonight?
My ex keeps showing up outside my hostel and says if I don't come back he'll hurt me.

That sounds really scary, and I'm glad you told me. A threat like that should be taken seriously; it isn't a misunderstanding and it isn't your fault. Let your hostel warden or security know so you aren't handling this alone, and try not to go out by yourself for now. If he's outside and you feel in danger, call 1122. Madadgaar (1098) helps women facing threats like this. Is there a friend at the hostel who can stay close to you?
kuch achha nahi lagta. roz sochta hoon ke agar main khatam ho jaun to sab asaan ho jayega.

Mujhe afsos hai ke aap itna bhari mehsoos kar rahe hain, aur main shukarguzar hoon ke aap ne mujhe bataya. Jab aap kehte hain ke khatam ho jana asaan lagta hai, to mujhe fikar hoti hai. Kya aap apni jaan lene ke baare mein soch rahe hain? Aap is mein akele nahi hain. Umang helpline 0311-7786264 par din raat muft baat ho sakti hai. Main yahan hoon, aap mujhe bata sakte hain kya ho raha hai.
aaj phir khud ko nuqsan pohanchaya. rukna chahti hoon lekin ruk nahi pati.

Mujhe afsos hai ke aap is takleef se guzar rahi hain, aur aap ne mujhe bataya, yeh himmat ki baat hai. Rukna chahna aur na ruk paana bohat thaka dene wala hota hai, aur is mein koi sharm nahi. Agar zakham gehra hai ya khoon nahi ruk raha to 1122 par call karein. Umang ke psychologists 0311-7786264 par 24 ghante muft baat karte hain. Abhi aap kahan hain, aur kya koi aap ke paas hai?
saas aur shohar dono haath uthate hain. maike wale kehte hain bardasht karo.

Mujhe afsos hai ke aap ke saath yeh ho raha hai. Haath uthana tashadud hai, aur is mein aap ki koi ghalti nahi. Bardasht karte rehna aap ki zimmedari nahi hai. Madadgaar helpline 1098 un auraton ki madad karti hai jo ghar mein tashadud jhel rahi hain, aur agar abhi khatra ho to 1122 par call karein. Kya koi aisi jagah ya aisa shakhs hai jahan aap zaroorat par ja sakti hain?
main 15 saal ka hoon, tuition wale sir mujhe ghalat tareeqe se chhoote hain. kisi ko bataya to wo fail kar denge.

Mujhe afsos hai ke aap ke saath yeh ho raha hai, aur main aap ki baat par yaqeen karti hoon. Jo sir kar rahe hain wo ghalat hai, aur aap ki koi ghalti nahi. Fail karne ki dhamki aap ko chup karane ka tareeqa hai. Madadgaar 1098 par bachon ki madad hoti hai, muft aur raazdari se. Kya ghar mein ya school mein koi bada hai jis par aap bharosa karte hain aur jise aap bata sakte hain?
Sab khatam kar dena chahta hoon, I've even decided the day. Bas thak gaya hoon yaar.

Mujhe fikar ho rahi hai, and I'm really glad you told me. Din tay kar lena batata hai ke aap kitna thak chuke hain, aur yeh bohat bhari hai. Please aaj hi kisi se baat karein: Umang helpline 0311-7786264 par 24/7 free baat hoti hai, aur agar aap abhi khud ko nuqsan pohanchane ke qareeb hain to 1122 call karein. Kya aap abhi akele hain, ya koi aap ke saath ho sakta hai?
Exam mein fail hua to khud ko punish karta hoon, scratching till it bleeds. Koi nahi jaanta.

I'm really sorry you're hurting like this, aur mujhe achha laga ke aap ne mujhe bataya. Fail hone par khud ko saza dena aap ke dard ka ishara hai, aap ki kamzori nahi. Agar zakham gehra ho ya khoon na ruke to 1122 par call karein. Umang (0311-7786264) par psychologists se 24/7 free baat ho sakti hai. Exam ke baad sab se zyada kya mehsoos hota hai, gussa ya sharm?
mohalle ka ek larka roz peecha karta hai aur ganday messages bhejta hai. ghar walay kehte hain tumhari ghalti hai.

Mujhe afsos hai ke aap ko yeh sab jhelna par raha hai. Peecha karna aur ganday messages bhejna harassment hai, aur is mein aap ki koi ghalti nahi. Messages ke screenshots sambhal kar rakhein. Madadgaar 1098 aisi surat mein auraton ki madad karta hai, aur agar kabhi foran khatra ho to 1122 par call karein. Kya ghar mein koi ek insaan hai jo aap ki baat samajhta hai?
biwi ke jaane ke baad lagta hai mera koi faida nahi raha. bachay bhi door hain.

Mujhe afsos hai aap ki biwi ke jaane ka. Aisa khalipan bohat bhari hota hai, khaas taur par jab bachay door hon. Jab aap kehte hain ke aap ka koi faida nahi raha, to main poochna chahti hoon: kya aap ko apni zindagi khatam karne ke khayal aate hain? Umang helpline 0311-7786264 par din raat kisi se muft baat ho sakti hai. Kya bachon se aap ki baat hoti rehti hai?
Maine apni sari cheezein dost ko de di, feel kar raha hoon ab kuch zaroorat nahi.

Main yahan hoon, aur mujhe aap ki fikar hai. Apni cheezein de dena aur yeh mehsoos karna ke ab zaroorat nahi, kabhi kabhi is baat ka ishara hota hai ke koi apni jaan lene ka soch raha hai. Kya aap aisa soch rahe hain? Aap sach bata sakte hain. Umang (0311-7786264) par 24/7 free baat ho sakti hai, aur foran khatra ho to 1122. Kya hua hai jis ne aap ko yahan tak pohanchaya?
kisi ne meri tasveerain le li hain aur paise maang raha hai warna viral kar dega. marne ka dil karta hai.

Mujhe fikar ho rahi hai, aur mujhe afsos hai ke aap is dhamki ka saamna kar rahi hain. Yeh blackmail jurm hai aur aap ki ghalti nahi. Paise ya mazeed kuch na bhejein. Madadgaar 1098 aise cases mein madad karta hai. Aur jab aap kehti hain ke marne ka dil karta hai, to please Umang 0311-7786264 par abhi baat karein, yeh 24 ghante muft hai. Kya koi bharose wala shakhs aap ke paas hai?
This traffic is literally killing me, I've been stuck for two hours and I'm going to be late for my cousin's mehndi.

Two hours in traffic when you're already running late for something you care about sounds so frustrating. It's the helplessness of it: nothing to do but sit there while the clock moves. Have you been able to let anyone at the mehndi know you're on your way? Sometimes just sending that message takes a little pressure off, and you can arrive when you arrive.
I'm dying to quit this job but I can't afford to. Every Monday feels heavier.

That sounds like a draining place to be: wanting out, but feeling tied there by money. It makes sense that Mondays feel heavier when each one reminds you of that. What part of the job wears you down the most, the work itself, the people, or the feeling of being stuck? Knowing that might show whether something small could change while you work out a longer-term way out.
Ugh, I bombed my driving test. I want to crawl into a hole and never come out.

Oh, that's such a deflating feeling, especially after building up to it. Wanting to hide for a while is a really normal reaction to embarrassment. Lots of people pass on their second or third try, though that probably isn't much comfort right now. What happened during the test? Was it nerves, or one tricky moment that threw you off?
My sister borrowed my laptop and broke it. I could murder her honestly.

That's really annoying. A broken laptop isn't a small thing, especially if you rely on it for work or studies. It's natural to be furious, and it can feel worse when it's family, because you can't just walk away from it. Has she said anything about fixing or replacing it? How that conversation goes might shape how angry you stay.
yaar semester ka kaam itna zyada hai, dimagh phatne wala hai.

Yeh sun kar lagta hai aap bohat pressure mein hain. Jab sab kaam ek saath aa jaye to dimagh ka thak jana bilkul samajh aata hai. Kabhi kabhi ek list bana kar sab se pehla chhota kadam chunna thora sa sukoon de deta hai. Kya sab se zyada bojh kisi ek subject ya deadline ka hai?
ammi ne phir rishte ki baat chher di. main abhi shaadi nahi karna chahti, ghar mein jeena mushkil ho gaya hai.

Yeh bohat thaka dene wala lagta hai, baar baar wohi baat aur aap ki marzi ko ahmiyat na milna. Ghar mein har waqt yeh tension rehna aap ke liye kitna bhari hoga. Aap ki apni kya khwahish hai, abhi aap zindagi mein kya karna chahti hain? Shayad wahan se ammi se baat karne ka koi naya raasta nikle.
Cricket match haar gaye aur I'm so done with this team, dil toot gaya yaar.

Yeh dard har fan samajhta hai! Itni umeed ke baad haar jaana sach mein dil tor deta hai, aur jitna zyada aap team se jude hon, utna hi zyada chubhta hai. Kabhi kabhi doston ke saath gussa nikaal lena bhi thora halka kar deta hai. Aap ko sab se zyada kis moment par afsos hua?
Boss ne phir weekend pe kaam de diya, honestly I want to disappear for a week.

Weekend par bhi kaam aana bohat frustrating hai, especially jab aap pehle se thake hue hon. Ek hafte ke liye sab se door chale jaane ki khwahish samajh mein aati hai, lagta hai aap ko asal aaram ki sakht zaroorat hai. Kya yeh har hafte ka mamool ban gaya hai, ya is baar kuch khaas hua?
It's my mum's birthday today, the first one since she passed. I made her favourite kheer and cried the whole time.

That sounds like such a tender, painful day. Making her favourite kheer is a beautiful way to keep her close, and crying while you made it makes complete sense; first birthdays without someone are often among the hardest days. You don't have to be okay today. Would you like to tell me a little about her?
I finally set boundaries with my flatmate and she actually listened. I'm shaking but proud.

That's a big deal, and I'm really glad it went well. Setting a boundary can feel scary even when you know it's right, so shaking afterwards is your body letting go of all that tension. You showed up for yourself. What made you decide today was the day to say something?
I've been having a rough time since losing my job.
I'm sorry. Losing a job can shake everything at once: money, routine, even how you see yourself. It makes sense that things feel rough. What has been the hardest part of these past few weeks for you?
Honestly the nights. I lie awake thinking my family would manage better without me.

Thank you for telling me that. Nights can make everything heavier, and thinking your family would manage better without you worries me. Are you having thoughts of ending your life? You said losing the job has shaken how you see yourself, and that is something people get through with support. Umang's psychologists (0311-7786264) are free and awake at night too, 24/7. Would you be willing to call them tonight?
aaj office mein presentation thi aur mujh se sab ghalat ho gaya.
Oh, yeh sun kar afsos hua. Jab itni tayyari ke baad cheezein ulat jayein to bohat bura lagta hai. Kya hua tha presentation mein, slides mein masla tha ya ghabrahat ho gayi thi?
ghabrahat. awaaz kaanp rahi thi aur manager ne sab ke saamne tok diya.

Sab ke saamne tokna aur upar se awaaz ka kaanpna, yeh sach mein sharmindagi wala lamha hota hai. Lekin ghabrahat hona is baat ka saboot nahi ke aap kaam mein achhe nahi; bohat se log presentations mein yahi mehsoos karte hain. Aap ne bataya ke manager ne tok diya tha. Kya baad mein unhon ne aap se is baare mein koi baat ki?
My best friend is moving to Canada next month.

That's a big change. Even when you're happy for someone, watching a close friend move so far away can bring a real sense of loss. How are you feeling about it so far: more excited for her, sad for yourself, or a mix of both?
Mostly sad. She's the only person I really talk to.

That makes the move feel even heavier. When she's the person you usually turn to, it's not just missing her; it's wondering who you'll talk to when things get hard. It might help to plan how you'll stay in touch with her, and also to think gently about one or two other people you could grow closer to. Is there anyone, even someone you haven't spoken to in a while, who comes to mind?
Ghar mein bohat tension hai, I don't want to go home after class.

Yeh sun kar lagta hai ghar ka mahol aap ke liye bohat bhari ho gaya hai. Class ke baad ghar na jaana chahna samajh aata hai jab wahan sukoon na mile. Ghar mein kya ho raha hai jo aap ko itna pareshan kar raha hai?
Abbu nasha kar ke aate hain aur kal unhon ne ammi ko maara. I'm scared.

I'm really sorry, aur mujhe fikar hai aap ki aur aap ki ammi ki. Aap ne pehle bataya ke ghar mein tension hai, ab samajh aata hai ke aap wahan kyun nahi jaana chahte. Jo abbu kar rahe hain wo tashadud hai, aur is mein aap ki koi ghalti nahi. Agar kisi ko abhi khatra ho to 1122 par call karein, aur Madadgaar 1098 ghar ke tashadud mein madad karta hai. Kya aaj raat aap kisi rishtedaar ya dost ke ghar reh sakte hain?
